I wrote the page to `./solution.tsx`. I couldn't run it, so it's untested.

- **Trigger:** a secondary "Delete project" button opens the modal.
- **Dialog:** I used the workspace's `AlertDialog`, which is built for destructive confirmations. It's titled "Delete this project?" and carries the description you gave.
- **Actions:** "Keep project" closes the dialog. The primary "Delete" button closes it and sets the status text "Project deleted." on the page.
- **Status text:** it sits in a `role="status"` paragraph that is always on the page, so screen readers announce it when it fills in.
- **Brand:** all colours come from the theme classes, so it should follow orrery light, orrery dark and solar. The three buttons have a minimum 44px touch target, taken from `--hit-target-min`.
